test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a key feature of the Constitution of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Promotion of feudalism__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** The following is a list of some of the **key elements of the Indian Constitution:**

__
 
• **Federalism:** Separation of federal and state powers
 
• **Government** by the People under a **Parliamentary System**
 
• **Fundamental Rights**: The division of powers between the legislative, executive, and judicial branches
 
• **Secularism**: Separation of State and Religion 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Feudalism **in** India** was defined by a **class of landowners** and a **class of subject peasants** who both lived in an **economy** that was mostly **agrarian,** characterised by a drop in trade and **urbanisation** as well as a sharp decline in the use of metal money.
 
• Promotion of feudalism is not a key feature or the basic feature of the Indian Constitution.
